newsitem.title: FRANCE: Valeo to invest close to 3 bln Ffr in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Valeo to invest close to 3 bln Ffr in 1997.

text.p: Car parts manufacturer Valeo plans to invest close to three billion francs in its industrial operations in 1997, chairman Noel Goutard said in an interview with the weekly magazine L'Expansion.
The group last year said it planned 2.3 billion francs of investments for 1996, up from 2.1 billion in 1995.
Goutard also said Valeo planned to increase research and development spending by 14 percent this year to around two billion francs.
"We will spend close to three billion francs in our industrial plant in 1997," he was quoted as saying.
He said the group had 11 billion francs of equity at the end of 1996 and debt of less than one billion francs.
"We could theoretically borrow four to five billion without any problem," he said.
He reiterated that the group aimed to grow faster than the market and sought to generate 40 billion francs in sales by the year 2000.
He said sales should exceed 30 billion francs in 1997 "from internal and external growth." Sales totalled 28.8 billion francs last year, up 14 percent.
